sourceNote: From the most recent published minutes — the AGM and ordinary meeting of Thursday 20 November 2025.

digest.decided: £2,000 ringfenced for Christmas food support — dinners at Largs Naz Church and BEC, Common Ground meals, the Foodbank and the Food Hub
digest.who: Action: LCC Access to Food group · proposed by CCllr Stevenson, agreed by all

digest.decided: Banking hub — Kenneth Gibson MSP to meet Link at Holyrood; Cash Access UK viewed possible temporary premises in town
digest.who: Action: Kenneth Gibson MSP · premises visit with Cllr Hill and Cllr Collier

digest.decided: Kerry Canning appointed to the Community Council; Alexander Hughes appointed adviser for youth
digest.who: New youth group formed — Alex with Tom, Robbie, Jamie and Kerry — to agree a plan

digest.decided: The Chair will step down in early 2026 — an interim Chair is sought until the elections
digest.who: CCllr Phillips · Community Council elections agreed for 2026 at September's meeting

digest.decided: Mackerston play area — around £350,000 of play-park funding expected; LCC asking NAC for the plans
digest.who: Action: LCC to NAC · following Kenneth Gibson MSP's enquiry (September)

digest.decided: Handrail for the beach steps at May Street — still being pursued with NAC after two reported injuries
digest.who: Action: Cllr Murdoch with NAC · LCC following progress (September)

meeting.venueNote: Recent meetings have been held at Vikingar.
